subject: general
question: The Ghadar Party was founded in _______ by Sohan Singh Bhakna, Kanshi Ram, Harnam Singh Tundilat, Lala Har Dayal and others.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1913**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ghadar Party was founded in the year **1913**.
 
• It was established by Sohan Singh Bhakna, Kanshi Ram, Harnam Singh Tundilat, Lala Har Dayal, and other prominent leaders.
 
• The party aimed at securing India's independence from British rule through revolutionary means.
 
• The Ghadar Party was headquartered in San Francisco, USA, and played a crucial role in mobilizing the Indian diaspora for the cause of India's freedom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The name "Ghadar" means "revolt" or "rebellion" in Urdu and Punjabi, reflecting the party's revolutionary objectives.
 
• The Ghadar Party published a newspaper called "Ghadar" which spread revolutionary messages and ideas among Indians worldwide.
 
• The party's activities included organizing uprisings, disseminating anti-British propaganda, and establishing contacts with other revolutionary groups.
 
• The Ghadar movement significantly influenced the Indian independence struggle, inspiring future generations of freedom fighters.
